root_idea.summary: The root has two principal orientations: bearing or carrying a load, and producing a forceful breath or audible sound.
root_idea.development: The load sense extends to burden-bearing, support, retinues, strength, and things that bear; the sound sense extends from forceful breathing to sighing, groaning, and roaring.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The Quran-attested noun زَفِيرٌ is a distinct lexical form with supported breathing and roaring senses.

senses.definition: A forceful, prolonged sigh or groan—the audible drawing in and release of breath.
senses.usage_conditions: In Quranic usage, it denotes the repeated, distress-filled breathing or sighing of the inhabitants of Hell.

senses.definition: A loud roaring sound produced by fiercely burning fire.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic fire image, the word denotes the audible roar of Hellfire rather than human breathing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To carry or bear a thing, load, or burden; also to draw and carry water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of carrying such things as a filled water-skin.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To roar or make a loud sound, of a tumultuous sea.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension of forceful sound, distinct here from the Quranic use for the roar of fire.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of the earth, to put forth plants or herbage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A heavy load or burden borne on the back or head.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The word can also refer to the burden that makes its bearer breathe heavily or groan.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A water-skin used for carrying water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Especially the skin carried by a herdsman or pastor; plural أَزْفَارٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A traveller's equipment or baggage, including the water-skin.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A collective designation for the apparatus carried on a journey.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A lamb.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separately attested lexical meaning, synonymous with حَمَلٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A prop or supporting branch of a tree.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A concrete supporting object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To move about in a confused or disorderly manner.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reported for the Form V verb in a hadith context, with the lexical attribution disputed in the cited discussion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To eat fatty food when breaking a fast.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported post-classical explanation of the Form V verb.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Grease, greasy food, or flesh-meat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Identified as a modern Arabic usage, with related colloquial senses of greasy, foul, or obscene.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A sea, or a large river resembling a sea, especially one characterized by roaring or abundant water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The water-body sense is figurative in its association with tumultuous sound or great carrying capacity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A large gift, likened to a sea in abundance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension of the abundant-water sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A liberal or exceptionally generous man.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative description based on the abundance associated with a sea.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who carries loads or has the strength to bear responsibilities.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The meaning extends physical load-bearing to the bearing of responsibilities.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A lord, master, chief, or other person of authority.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative development from the one who bears or undertakes burdens.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A courageous man.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An attributed figurative usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A lion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative designation associated with strength and courage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A forceful drawing in or prolonged emission of breath: a sigh, vehement sigh, or groan.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The feminine noun can describe breath drawn in distress or emitted after the chest has been filled.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person breathing in the manner described by زَفْرَةٌ.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The passage reports this interpretation but notes that the wording may be a mistranscription and could instead concern a place of breathing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The middle of a thing or horse; the chest or belly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of bodily breadth or the central part of an object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The strongly knit structure of an animal's joints.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a camel or other beast whose joints are notably firm and compact.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A calamity or misfortune.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Classical Arabic meaning of the noun distinct from its Quranic breath and roaring senses.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who carries or helps to carry loads or burdens.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural زَوَافِرُ is also used for female slaves who carry water-skins or other loads.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A bulky camel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The description is connected with the animal's capacity to carry loads.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The withers or upper back next to the neck.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The part upon which loads are borne.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The supporting side or angle of a building; a structural prop.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also used figuratively for a prop that strengthens something, such as glory.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person's supporters, assistants, kinsfolk, or tribe; those who undertake his affairs or bear his burdens.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In political or official contexts, it can denote the representative or chief who conducts a group's business with a ruler.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A company or assembled body of men, including an army or troop.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The same collective sense may denote a collected military unit.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A rib.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Usually encountered in the plural زَوَافِرُ, especially in descriptions of a horse's strong ribs.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A bow.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative or sound-associated designation; plural زَوَافِرُ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The portion of an arrow exclusive of its feathers, especially the section near the head.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The exact extent varies among the cited descriptions; the term is also applied to a corresponding part of a spear.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The female of the tiger.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A fixed lexical expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A horse large in the sides, ribs, chest, belly, or middle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjective describing a broad-bodied horse.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The pudendum or genital opening.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A substantivized anatomical term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A beast or camel whose joints are strongly knit; compactly built.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of an animal's firmly compacted physical constitution.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The breast or forepart of a horse from which the breathing called زَفِيرٌ proceeds.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specifically anatomical term associated with forceful breathing.

cautions: The Quranic noun زَفِيرٌ has a breath or sigh sense and a fire-roar sense; the contextual distinction is semantic and constructional, not morphological.
The reported breather interpretation under زَفْرَةٌ is textually uncertain because the cited passage itself allows for a possible mistranscription.
